title: Intrafirm Knowledge Sharing in the Investment Research Industry
eligible_reason: Not a staggered-adoption DiD. The treatment debt_cle (equity analyst has in-house access to an all-star debt analyst covering the company's sector in year t) is a binary indicator that switches on and off at the analyst-broker-sector-year level, and the main tables regress analyst-company-year outcomes on debt_cle, a distress indicator, their interaction and about 10-15 time-varying analyst and company controls, with probit (dummy_cps issuance) or OLS with two-way clustering (cluster2) and no analyst or company fixed effects; later tables use analyst, year and industry FE with the same controls. The staggered 'gain access' events (gain_access_refine.dta) are used only to build the instrument for the IV tests in Table 5 (predicted_debt_cle via debt-analyst turnover and adjusted arrival). No column reports a binary treatment with unit and calendar-time FE and no controls.
design_notes: Two samples: MS_CF_Sample.dta (analyst-company-year, cash-flow forecasts; Tables 1, 2, 5A, 6A, 7A, 8A via CF_Sample_MS.do) and MS_CR_Sample.dta (analyst-company-rating-downgrade year; Tables 3, 4, 5B, 6B, 7B, 8B via CR_Sample_MS.do). Table 2A: version 10.1: xi: probit2 dummy_cps debt_cle zdistress debt_cle_zdistress <controls> iyear i.si, fcluster(estimato) tcluster(cyear). Table 2B: xi: cluster2 m_afe debt_cle zdistress debt_cle_zdistress <controls>, two-way cluster (estimato, ii_year), no FE. Table 5: reghdfe outcome wA1..wA6 (predicted access) <controls>, absorb(i.si i.analys i.fyear) cluster(estimato fyear) on gain_sample==1 (IV second stage; first stage reghdfe debt_cle wadjarrival ...). Tables 6-8: cross-sectional moderators (debt underwriting, debt conferences, multi-award, CFA, culture, colocation).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Access gains occur in many years (gain_access_refine.dta lists first access years) but are not used as a staggered-adoption event study; access also switches off (gain_lose_access_sample_113021.dta).

specs.exclusion_reason: no unit or time FE; time-varying controls; treatment switches on and off; interaction with distress
specs.outcome: m_afe (mean-adjusted cash flow forecast error, sign-flipped)
specs.treatment_definition: 1 if the analyst's broker employs an Institutional Investor all-star debt analyst in the company's sector in the award year
specs.controls: wcps_rfreq wfcps_rhorizon wcps_rbsize eq_1y aa_equi0 wcps_rfexp wcps_rnind wcps_rnfirm (time-varying)
specs.notes: Panel A (line 88) is a probit for dummy_cps with iyear trend and industry dummies.

specs.exclusion_reason: IV (predicted access); analyst, year and industry FE but not unit (analyst-company) FE; time-varying controls
specs.treatment_var: wA1 ... wA6 (predicted debt_cle from first stage on wadjarrival)
specs.treatment_definition: instrumented access using debt-analyst turnover / adjusted arrival
specs.controls: wp_rdate_bhar_91_180 wp_surprise p_loss ead weps_guide_news_180_91 wp_mv wp_mtb wp_leverage wbsize eq_1y aa_equi0 weps_fexp wnind wnfirm whorizon
specs.data_file: MS_CR_Sample.dta merged with gain_lose_access_sample_113021.dta, turnover_analysts.dta, allbrokeryears.dta
specs.reported_location: Table 5, Panel B (Panel A analogue in CF_Sample_MS.do from line 239)

data_files: analyst_colocation.dta, analyst_colocation_cr.dta, turnover_analysts.dta, gain_access_refine.dta, allbrokeryears.dta, predicted_debt_cle.dta, gain_lose_access_sample_113021.dta
data_files_note: All analysis datasets listed in readme.docx are present (built from IBES, Institutional Investor, Capital IQ, Compustat, SDC, Glassdoor, LinkedIn, CRSP; licensed sources but the merged files are shipped).
software_notes: Stata with user ado files xi3, cluster2, probit2 (shipped), reghdfe, winsor.
priority_note: Not eligible: no staggered-adoption TWFE design; probit / two-way-clustered OLS with controls and IV.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). The full-text 'staggered' hit likely refers to the staggered timing of debt-analyst turnover used for the instrument.
